REVIEWED EVIDENCE EXCERPT — NOT A COMPLETE MANUAL OR A NETWORK SCAN
PostgreSQL 18: pg_verifybackup
https://www.postgresql.org/docs/18/app-pgverifybackup.html
Publisher: The PostgreSQL Global Development Group
Sections: Description; Options --quiet; Examples
Rights: PostgreSQL License; https://www.postgresql.org/about/licence/
Change notice: selected excerpts; whitespace normalized. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt and licenses/.
pg_verifybackup is used to check the integrity of a database cluster backup taken using pg_basebackup against a backup_manifest generated by the server at the time of the backup.
$ pg_basebackup -h mydbserver -D /usr/local/pgsql/data
$ pg_verifybackup /usr/local/pgsql/data
Don't print anything when a backup is successfully verified.
Even if you use this tool, you should still perform test restores and verify that the resulting databases work as expected and that they appear to contain the correct data.
